sections.title: An overview of this role
paras: As a Customer Success Architect, you’ll be a strategic advisor to some of GitLab’s most important customers, helping them connect our DevSecOps platform to their business goals and realize meaningful, long-term outcomes. You’ll partner closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into concrete success plans, guide them along the customer journey, and drive hands-on enablement, adoption, utilization, and maturity. Reporting into a Senior Manager within our North America Customer Success organization, you’ll own a book of customers, act as their primary GitLab liaison for questions and escalations, and coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support so customers can navigate complex technical and organizational challenges with confidence.

You’ll use your understanding of Git, software development lifecycles, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices to help customers adopt best practices and stay current with new GitLab capabilities. In your first year, success looks like building strong, consultative relationships with key stakeholders, increasing adoption of the GitLab platform, and strengthening retention, growth, and customer satisfaction across your portfolio.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Partner with customers to translate pre-sales command plans and desired business outcomes into actionable objectives and clear success criteria.
Guide customers on how to best use the GitLab platform, including common DevSecOps best practices, Git workflows, CI/CD, and adoption patterns.
Own a book of customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic and technical engagement.
Build and maintain Customer Success Plans, define critical goals and key performance indicators, and track progress with customers over time.
Act as the primary GitLab liaison for assigned accounts, coordinating responses to questions, issues, and escalations across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.
Provide hands-on technical enablement and onboarding, including education on new GitLab features, releases, and relevant use cases.
Program manage account escalations, ensuring root causes are understood, follow-up actions are owned, and stakeholders are informed.
Collaborate with Services and other internal teams to identify and recommend training, enablement, and maturity opportunities aligned to customer needs.

sections.title: What you’ll bring
bullets: Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and modern software development lifecycles.
Working knowledge of continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.
Experience partnering with customers to define business outcomes and translate them into actionable success plans, key goals, and measures.
Background in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles focused on adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
Ability to manage a portfolio of customers, including handling escalations and coordinating across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.
Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and analytical thinking.
Experience planning and managing projects or initiatives in technical environments, including identifying training and enablement needs.
Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in applying transferable skills from related roles or industries, with flexibility to travel as needed according to company policy.

paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Gusto is building its own P&C insurance agency — moving from a third-party referral model to a first-party, payroll-integrated experience that protects small businesses as they grow. We have policies in force and a growing book of business. What we don't yet have is a licensed account manager inside the company servicing it. You'll be our first, and the foundation of the service function: owning daily servicing of the book, running the proactive outreach that keeps clients correctly covered, and turning every recurring case into a product spec so the next hundred don't need a human.

sections.title: About the Team:
paras: The Business Insurance team is building Gusto's P&C insurance agency from the ground up, across core small commercial lines including Workers' Compensation. We partner closely with carrier counterparts and work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, design, data, sales, and licensed insurance professionals to ship a quote, bind, and service experience that's fast, accurate, and easy to manage over time. The team is small, cross-functional, and highly execution-oriented — ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants to build durable operations in a zero-to-one environment.

sections.title: Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
bullets: Own daily servicing of the assigned book: endorsements, certificates of insurance, coverage questions, premium audits, billing disputes, cancellations, reinstatements, and renewals.
Accountable for outcomes connected to Business Insurance customers.
Serve as the liaison between insureds, carriers, and our licensed producers — explaining coverage, exclusions, and exposures in plain language.
Run proactive outreach using payroll data a traditional agency doesn't have: catching FEIN mismatches, new-state hires, and class code drift before they become coverage gaps.
Work the pending cancellation and non-pay queue — find out what's actually driving each cancellation, fix what's fixable, and secure reinstatement or replacement coverage.
Handle claims intake and status reporting, and coordinate hand-offs to the carrier's adjusting team.

Document every recurring case as a product spec, partnering with product and engineering to automate certificate generation, endorsement submission, and intake triage — using AI tools daily for drafting, summarization, and triage.
Write the SOPs, escalation paths, and service standards for the team

jobs.summary:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Flexport.org is the humanitarian arm of Flexport. We serve nonprofits, NGOs, and mission-driven organizations that need to move impactful cargo reliably, often into some of the hardest environments to reach. As humanitarian and development needs keep climbing, the supply chain expertise our partners can count on matters more than ever.

You'll own some of Flexport.org's most complex and highest-impact partner relationships. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes: ocean, air, trucking, and customs, and demand real supply chain fluency to navigate well. You won't just manage these relationships, you'll shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every partner engagement, lead business reviews that drive real decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to help partners do more with what they have. You'll operate with full autonomy, hold a high bar on program growth and retention, and become someone junior teammates turn to for guidance.

sections.title: You Will
bullets: Own end-to-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi-modal Flexport.org partner accounts, including partners with significant program growth potential and high operational intensity.
Lead RFP bids and contract renewals end-to-end.

Serve as a true strategic partner to nonprofits, NGOs, and mission-driven organizations, going deep on their supply chain operations to find where Flexport can cut cost, add capability, or move faster.
Lead high-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting. Bring market context, multi-modal insight, and recommendations tailored to each partner's mission and constraints.
Drive expansion across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding program growth and retention targets.
Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Legal, Trade Lane Management, and other Flexport.org teams on solutions that need internal alignment and creative problem-solving.
Mentor account teammates: share playbooks, join key partner calls, and help the team raise its game.
Use AI-enabled tools to automate and improve internal and partner-facing processes where it makes the work faster or better.

sections.title: You Should Have
bullets: 5+ years in account management, business development, or a similar partner-facing role. A background in logistics, supply chain, humanitarian aid, or international development is strongly preferred.
A track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi-product book of business.
Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes. You can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
Comfort operating without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations, and the judgment to write the playbook for others once you've solved it.
Strong commercial instincts: you spot growth opportunities before partners ask, and you close them.
Genuine curiosity about the humanitarian and development space. You want to become an expert in aid logistics, not just move freight.
A natural tendency to develop others. Peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
A compliance-first mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and our partners and regulators need to trust us.

sections.title: You Will Get
bullets: Ownership of Flexport.org's most complex and meaningful partner relationships, the accounts where the impact is biggest.
A visible role in shaping how the Flexport.org account team operates. Your judgment and approach set the standard.
Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
A front-row seat on Flexport.org's mission: getting aid to the people who need it, on time.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Lead Executive Business Reviews that change how a customer thinks about Ramp: from one vendor in the stack to the system their finance function runs on.

Quarterback outcomes across implementation, product, engineering, and CX - on new deals and on escalations, where trust is either earned or lost.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

sections.title: Instacart is a Flex First team

sections.title: Why this role is on the menu
paras: Instacart’s retail media platform, Carrot Ads, is scaling fast — and the strategic retail partners who power it need more than a point of contact. They need a trusted advisor who knows their business, knows ours, and can translate that into advertising performance that grows over time. Without this role, we risk leaving adoption on the table, missing signals from partners who could shape our product roadmap, and letting high-potential relationships stagnate. We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of enterprise retail partners end-to-end — from onboarding through growth — and make Carrot Ads an indispensable part of how they compete. This role sits at the center of Instacart’s retail media expansion, with a direct line of sight to partner revenue, product adoption, and the future of how we go to market.

sections.title: What you’ll cook up in your first year
bullets: A portfolio of strategic enterprise retail partners is measurably healthier — adoption is up, revenue is growing, and partners are pointing to Carrot Ads as a competitive advantage.

Drives business transformation by leading strategic customer engagements to deeply understand current operations, proactively recommending workflow transformations and architecting joint success plans that define the metrics and timelines necessary to remove barriers and deliver business value.

Orchestrates executive business reviews for our most complex partnerships, leading the narrative with our customer’s decision-makers to anticipate future operational risks and align multi-year business transformations with Samsara’s long-term roadmap.
Influences internal roadmaps across Product, Finance, and Support to drive mission-critical customer initiatives.

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the founding Channel Partner Manager for Canada, you will build the partner motion that helps Canadian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt Ramp through trusted advisors and ecosystem partners.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the full partner lifecycle, from identifying and engaging Canadian accounting, advisory, private equity, and venture capital partners through signing, enablement, activation, and partner-sourced pipeline. Your early results will help determine how Ramp scales its Canadian channel motion.

You will work closely with Sales, Growth, Product, Engineering, and the broader Partnerships organization. The right person is a hands-on builder: equally comfortable opening a new relationship, running a partner meeting, solving an operational blocker, and turning early learnings into a repeatable playbook.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Build Ramp’s Canadian channel strategy and operating rhythm from the ground up.
Research, identify, source, qualify and sign net-new Canadian partners.
Create joint go-to-market and activation plans to grow the Canadian partner ecosystem.
Drive revenue for Ramp through generating referrals
Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and operators inside partner orgs
Educate partners on Ramp’s Canadian capabilities, value prop and updates.
Own partner onboarding, activation, pipeline generation, and regular business reviews.
Work closely with the Canadian Sales team to advance partner-referred opportunities.

sections.title: What You’ll Need

High agency, urgency, and resilience
Proven track record of sourcing and managing partnerships
Self-starter mindset: you are comfortable getting in the weeds

jobs.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. sections.title: What Makes Cloudflare Special?

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

sections.title: About the role:
paras: Do you want to join a dynamic, creative team? Samsara's Customer & Partner Education team is looking for a trainer to help us scale our reach and customer support globally. As a Senior Product Training Specialist focused primarily on our Scale segment (i.e. Commercial and Mid-market accounts), you'll help thousands of customers derive immediate value from our connected operations platform. Across one:many digital programs, live webinars, and cohort-based training sessions, you'll guide customers through structured learning journeys, make complex platform concepts accessible and actionable, and ensure success at every stage of their journey — across transportation, construction, field services, and the many other industries Samsara serves.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

sections.title: Minimum requirements for the role:
bullets: Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. You make complex platform concepts clear and compelling for large, diverse audiences, both in your verbal delivery and in the materials you produce.
Demonstrated experience delivering at-scale programs and live webinars or vILT to external audiences.
Excellent interpersonal skills. You're dynamic and enthusiastic, and you connect well with people at any level of an organization.
Ability to build digital learning assets when needed, e.g., video tutorials, job aids, and presentation decks, using AI models, authoring and editing tools.
A working grasp of instructional design: you structure content around clear learning objectives and can help shape a program, not just deliver it.
Self-directed and analytical. You can teach yourself new products and tools quickly and assess what customers most need to know.
Ability to analyze engagement and impact data, then iterate on your content to improve what's working and fix what isn't.
Strong prioritization skills. You handle multiple programs and sessions concurrently while staying organized, methodical, and detail-oriented.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to…

sections.title: An overview of this role
paras: As a Senior Professional Services Engineer, you'll own delivery workstreams on federal engagements in FedRAMP-authorized cloud environments, Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Level 4 and 5 enclaves, and fully disconnected networks. You'll install and configure GitLab in classified and air-gapped environments, migrate agencies from legacy tooling, train government technical staff, and advise customers on how GitLab fits their security and compliance posture.

You'll work directly with program managers, engagement managers, Federal account teams, and agency stakeholders. You'll also collaborate with GitLab Product and Engineering when customer requirements don't have a clear answer yet, which happens often in this segment.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Deliver assigned Statement of Work scope independently, completing agreed engagement deliverables and escalating architecture decisions to technical architects and senior engineers.

Install, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and tune GitLab reference architectures in cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments, including Geo, high-availability topologies, and Kubernetes-based deployments.
Complete GitLab installations and upgrades in disconnected networks using offline package management, container registry mirroring, and dependency staging.
Build and carry out migration plans from Bitbucket, GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, and legacy version control systems to GitLab Self-Managed or GitLab Dedicated for Government.

Serve as the primary technical contact for agency engineering and security teams, and run workshops and enablement sessions for government developers, platform teams, and information system security officers.

Translate agency compliance requirements into GitLab configurations, clearly identify where GitLab doesn't yet meet a control, and support authorization work with the technical artifacts and evidence assessors request.

Document implementations, create reusable runbooks and automation, flag scope changes and risks early, support Associate engineers, improve Professional Services delivery practices, and share federal compliance gaps with Product and Engineering.

sections.title: What you’ll bring
bullets: Experience delivering infrastructure or platform work in a customer-facing or consulting role, with the ability to work independently across concurrent engagements.

This role requires an active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI), Full Scope Polygraph clearance and the ability to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. This role is currently available only to candidates in the DC Metro area.

Due to government security requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to be eligible for this position.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.
Experience working with major cloud providers, including exposure to government regions such as Amazon Web Services GovCloud, Azure Government, or Google Assured Workloads.

Demonstrated experience deploying and administering GitLab, including continuous integration and continuous delivery, the container registry, and Premium or Ultimate features, plus production experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Clear written and verbal communication with mixed technical audiences.
Prior GitLab Professional Services, federal systems integrator, or agency delivery experience.

sections.title: About the team
paras: We help government customers deploy and use GitLab in highly controlled environments. We work with engagement managers, Federal account teams, agency stakeholders, and GitLab Product and Engineering to deliver secure implementations, support authorization needs, and turn field findings into better delivery practices and product feedback.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity .
